meta.title: Ondra Proactive Reason
meta.description: What to bring up right now. Eight kinds of candidates queue by priority: the thing she is still chewing on comes first, then what she promised, what is sitting heavy on her, what she has to do, what just happened, this day in a past year, the current surroundings, and a fallback line pool last. Weight only ranks within a kind — the handbook calls it priority, not a score. The same matter is raised once every three days, and the cooldown keys on the matter itself rather than on the wording.
